#### A.7.4 Unary Operators

Expressions with unary operators group right-to-left.

    unary-expression:
      postfix expression
      ++unary expression
      --unary expression
      unary-operator cast-expression
      sizeof unary-expression
      sizeof(type-name)

    unary operator: one of
      & \* + - ~ !
